items.information: Se vai competir pela primeira vez, certifique-se de ler todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2024#40321-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2024#41738-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2024#43048-associados-aps-aps-associates). If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2024#40321-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2024#41738-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2024#43048-associados-aps-aps-associates). ​ **Espectadores podem assistir gratuitamente! | Spectators may attend for free!** ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaWgwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e4e64a0c3d80133e2644e1861f7a6021e30553d4/logo_wca_website.png) **Segue o nosso [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/portugalchampionship2024/)! | Follow our [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/portugalchampionship2024/)!**
